thread:
nina: Hi team — putting this here so everything is visible. I submitted my resignation last week; last working day will be 2026-07-23 (two weeks). Want to confirm offboarding steps: benefits end dates, laptop return, badge, and exit interview. Thanks.

lisa (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, @nina. We'll run the standard offboard but there are two specifics: 1) COBRA opt-in window starts the day after your last active coverage date; 2) because you were on a 1099-transfer contract for the past month, we need to coordinate final invoice vs payroll. I'll DM details but will post checklist here. :memo:

raj: Thanks @nina. Can you confirm handoff for the search-routing project? Also please block 2 hours on your calendar tomorrow for a handover with @raj and @avery.

nina: Yep — I'll add a calendar invite for 11am tomorrow and drop a short playbook in the repo (README: HANDOFF.md).

avery (IT): For hardware: do you want courier pickup or will you drop off to HQ? We can schedule pickup on 7/24 morning. Also note SSO and API tokens will be revoked at 6pm on your last working day (2026-07-23). If you need short-lived access while filing final invoices we can create a 48h vendor token after deprovisioning.

kelly (Finance): Payroll note: if you need pro-rated payout for July, submit any outstanding expense reports by 2026-07-24 @ 12:00pm PT. For contractors converting to vendors, we need an invoice by 7/30 to process vendor payment. If you want payroll instead, confirm by EOD Monday so we can tax appropriately.

lisa (People Ops): COBRA timeline: your active coverage end date will be 2026-07-31 (end of month). COBRA notice will be emailed on 2026-08-01 with a 60-day election window. If you elect COBRA, coverage will be retroactive to 8/1. Link to the opt-in form (People Ops doc): https://redwood-internal/people/cobra-optin

nina: Thanks. My preference is vendor invoice for the last month. I'll upload an invoice to the finance portal by 7/28. Also I can do courier drop at HQ on 7/24 morning — easier for me.

avery (IT): Great — courier pickup canceled. Please wipe the laptop and keep a copy of any personal files before dropoff. We will sanitize and reimage after return. For repo/key transfer: share a list of service accounts and repos you own. Quick command you can paste here:```bash
gh repo list redwood --limit 200 --json name,owner,permission
```We'll use that to make sure ownership transfers are queued.

lisa (People Ops): Exit interview: we usually schedule a 30–45 min with People Ops. @nina do you prefer a video or quick phone? We can do 7/22 or 7/23 afternoon.

nina: Prefer video, 7/22 at 3pm works.

offboard-bot: [Automated checklist created] Tasks: 
• Schedule exit interview (assigned: lisa)
• Create deprovision ticket (assigned: avery)
• Confirm final pay / invoice (assigned: kelly)
• Badge deactivation (scheduled: 2026-07-23 17:00 PT)
• COBRA notice send (scheduled: 2026-08-01)

kelly (Finance): @nina — quick Q re: reimbursement — do you have a company phone stipend this quarter? If yes include that in expenses.

nina: No phone stipend this quarter.

raj: Small note on access: please delegate any active Grafana dashboards to @raj before your last day. If you need help we can pair tomorrow after the handoff.

nina: Will do — I'll add you as owner on the dashboards and update the alerting runbook.

avery (IT): Badge: deactivation scheduled for 2026-07-23 17:00 PT. If you need building access for pickup on 7/24 please let us know and we'll make a one-time pass valid 07/24 08:00-12:00.

nina: I will drop off on 7/24 09:30 — please create one-time pass.

avery (IT): Done — one-time pass created and emailed to you.

lisa (People Ops): Final checklist for @nina before we close ticket: 1) RSVP exit interview (7/22 3pm), 2) drop laptop 7/24 at HQ, 3) submit vendor invoice by 7/28, 4) transfer repo/SA ownership, 5) any outstanding expenses in by 7/24 12pm PT. After last day we'll send COBRA and confirm deprovision completed.

nina: Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear timeline. :pray:
